question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"the."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a definite article to refer to a specific blank number, which is** "blank number 3."**
 
• **"The"** is the definite article, indicating a specific noun, which is the blank number in this case.
 
 
• **Example**:* "I love to sail over **the**__ water" (some specific body of water) or "I love to sail over water" (any water).*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is **Option 3.**

Correct passage:

Dandelion is a widely distributed weed of the daisy family, __with__ a rosette of leaves and large bright yellow flowers followed __by__ globular heads of seeds with downy tufts. I also reminded them that April is designated as the Month of __**the**__ Military Child. Not many would know that 15 April is the day when we wear purple, or so to say, we ‘purple ______ (4) ______’ to express our solidarity and support ______ (5) ______ the strength and sacrifices of our children, while their fathers are deployed at Siachen Glacier, deserts and on our borders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "a" **is an indefinite article used to refer to a non-specific noun.

 
 
• **Example**: *"I need a pen."*
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "Zero article" **is used when no article is needed, usually with plural or uncountable nouns.
 
 
• **Example**: *"I like apples."*
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "an"** is an indefinite article used before a word that starts with a vowel sound.
 
 
• **Example**: *"An apple a day keeps the doctor away."*
